packages.name: Ctx
packages.reason: Compromised to steal AWS credentials and environment variables.

packages.name: pymafka
packages.reason: Mimicked the popular PyKafka client and delivered Cobalt Strike to devices.

analysis: The text describes two incidents involving malicious packages on PyPI. The 'Ctx' package was compromised to steal sensitive information such as AWS credentials. The 'pymafka' package was a malicious imitation of the PyKafka client, used to deliver Cobalt Strike. Both incidents highlight the risks of supply chain attacks in software repositories.
